name: Adafruit DAP library - Nivalo maintained fork

maintenance.scope: STM32 target identification and verified SWD programming support required by Nivalo OTA
maintenance.updatePolicy: Import a reviewed upstream tag, retain upstream history and license, carry the smallest tested patch set, and rebase after each upstream security or compatibility release.

activationGate: Repository builds use the reviewed local source. A remote or registry publication still requires explicit owner approval.
